title: A normalized affine singleton comparison lifts every target section.
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, $u:U\to X$ and $w:W\to X$ affine objects of the small etale site, $g:W\to U$ an $X$-morphism, and $n\in\mathbf N$. Let $f$ be an additive homomorphism from degree $n$ of the lifted Amitsur complex to degree $n$ of the singleton tensor-section Cech complex, satisfying the pure-tensor normalization [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison-hom-normalization]. Then for every target element $y$ there is a source element $x$ with $f(x)=y$.

source.place: Tag 03P2, affine tensor calculation, using Tags 01I4, 01JQ, 01I9, 01IA

proof.text: Let P be the iterated product and q the target evaluation at its unique outer index followed by ULift.down. productUniqueIso identifies evaluation with an isomorphism; ULift.down is injective. Hence q is injective.

Normalized pure sections belong to the range of q composed with f. On affine U and W these sections generate all sections on P. Since the range is an additive subgroup, closure_le implies that this range is the whole section group.
For a target y, q(y) lies in the range of q composed with f. Choose x with q(f(x))=q(y). Injectivity of q gives f(x)=y.
